english.title: Public weighing / measuring appointee make a false record of the weighing / measurement
english.standardoffencewording:

(A)_[weighing]_
(B)_[measuring]_

by means of equipment which was available for use by the public in accordance with section 20(1) of the Weights and Measures Act 1985, namely **(..SPECIFY EQUIPMENT..), made a false record of the

english.legislation: Contrary to sections 20(3)(a) and 84(6) of the Weights and Measures Act 1985.

english.notes: Section 83 of the Weights and Measures Act 1985 provides that in England and Wales, proceedings for any offence under this Act or any instrument made under this Act. shall not be instituted except by or on behalf of a local weights and measures authority or the chief officer of police for a police area.

other.penalty:
Summary: A fine not exceeding level three on the standard scale.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
